label: Bible Study
prompt: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the _____ fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
verse: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
note: Jericho, day seven — trumpets, a shout, and a city wall that simply gave up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have _____.
verse: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
note: God sends an Angel ahead to guard the road — and the destination is already prepared.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is _____ in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
verse: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
note: Gideon's objection: my family is poor and I'm the least in my father's house — just the kind of man God likes to use.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the _____ of the LORD it shall be seen.
verse: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
note: After the ram in the thicket, Abraham names the place 'The LORD will provide' — and it became a proverb.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Till I come, give _____ to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verse: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
note: Paul's job description for young Timothy until he arrives: give 'attendance to reading,' exhortation, doctrine.
